findings.desc: scripts/verify-runtime-reviewer-contract.mjs:67 hardcoded worktree guard only matches a single quoted .worktrees/B-*/packages/main/dist/cli.js literal. It would miss the original regression shape const worktreeRoot=".../.worktrees/B-xxxx" followed by join(worktreeRoot,"packages/main/dist/cli.js"), so the hardcoded-path contract is not actually guarding the bug class it was added for. Apply the same broader source scan to runtime health too.

scripts/audit-silent-catches.mjs:46 uses file:line:snippet as the baseline key. Any unrelated line insertion above an existing legacy catch will turn the old key into resolved debt and the same catch into newUncategorized, failing audit:silent-catches even though no new silent catch was added. Use a line-stable identity such as file plus catch ordinal/context hash, and keep line number as display metadata.
